protocol.domain: two explicitly identified scalar linear tasks y = w_task * x
protocol.learner: per-task least squares through origin; coefficients learned, task decomposition supplied

decision.first_task: adopt iff validation improves and retention gate passes
decision.second_task: new-task-only must be rejected if old-task MSE rises; replay and modular preservation evaluated under same gate
decision.withdrawal: dependent active version disabled and dependent weights removed by explicit forget
decision.changed_domain: withdraw obsolete observations, fit new coefficient, and validate on new held-out targets

limits: Synthetic software and learning-control experiment, not a scientific reserved test or neural learning claim
Task identifier and linear hypothesis class are supplied, not discovered
Selected training rows are disjoint by source ID and numerical content from held-out and retention rows
Protocol and source hashes are saved before fitting; wall time and RSS depend on machine
